name: read_range
author: hprebar
title: Read range
description: Read cell values, formulas, or formatted text from a worksheet range (e.g. 'A1:D10') or named range into JSON. Supports fast batch array reads. Read-only.
notes: COM: Uses Range.Value2 batch 2D array read for maximum performance. Headless: Uses ClosedXML IXLRange.

range.description: Cell range address (e.g. 'A1:C10', 'Sheet2!B5:E20') or named range. If omitted, reads the worksheet's used range.

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Defaults to active worksheet.

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path. Defaults to active workbook.

outputFormat.description: Output representation: 'values' (raw values), 'formulas' (formulas if present), 'formatted' (display text).

hasHeaders.description: If true, treats the first row as headers and returns an array of JSON objects.

maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows to return.
